args.content: Demo walkthrough: Atlas writes every memory to Walrus Memory on Sui mainnet, and the Walrus Memory Move package is 0xe7c16fbea0560e7057e2bf7422feaa4fb313749fc69c9e9092fac7a33b81d7f5. Tatum's Sui RPC gateway verifies the package before the next agent trusts the claim.
